description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1829/17, Homagama D/S Division & other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying land parcel classifications, extents, and encumbrance details for multiple properties. It contains detailed land registration information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, block numbers, and specific land measurements - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
